name: gitops
description: The whole lab as one repo: Proxmox, OpenTofu, Docker stacks, Authentik, Vault, Grafana, MikroTik. Treated like production, not a junk drawer of compose files.

name: headroom
description: Compress tool outputs, logs, and RAG chunks before they hit the model. Fewer tokens, same answers. Library, proxy, and MCP server.

name: cassandra-snapshot-tools
description: Create, move, and restore keyspace snapshots across Apache and DataStax Cassandra clusters.

name: postgres-init
description: Postgres image that runs a bootstrap script on every start. Useful when you want a known database state without migrations.
